title: decision_record/v1
description: The product: one legible per-turn audit record at decisions/NNNN.json (NNNN = zero-padded 4-digit turn index; every turn gets a record, INCLUDING missed/timeout turns, so the NNNN<->turn mapping is total and gap-free). It is a MATERIALIZED DERIVED VIEW over events.jsonl, assembled by a pure function of the event stream: every field must byte-equal its source event payloads (the replay verifier regenerates records from events and diffs; on conflict, events win). Deliberately denormalized: an auditor opens ONE file and reads the whole story - saw, said, meant, rules, happened, cost to hold, account after.

schema.description: Schema name and major version of this document.

run_id.description: Run this record belongs to (matches bundle_manifest.run_id).

turn.description: Decision-turn index; equals the NNNN of this file's name.

bar_index.description: Decision bar observed (at its close) this turn.

ts.description: Virtual clock at observation emission, REAL UTC epoch-milliseconds (bundle side; only observations are rebased).

saw.description: WHAT THE AGENT SAW: content address of the exact canonical observation; full bytes stored in-bundle at the ref (SCH-5 'from stored data alone').

observation_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the JCS observation bytes; must equal ObservationEmitted.observation_sha256 and the hash of the stored file.

said.description: WHAT THE AGENT SAID: every attempt, verbatim via content address. Empty attempts array = no response at all (timeout/unreachable); the absence is itself evidence.

attempts.description: One entry per IC-6 attempt, in order, including malformed ones.

raw_ref.description: Bundle-relative path of the verbatim response bytes, e.g. 'raw/0007-a1.txt'. Under the share redaction profile the file may be absent (listed in redaction.json); the hash still verifies what was said.

raw_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the verbatim response bytes.

latency_ms.description: Harness-measured wall latency for this attempt (recorded, never consumed).

http_status.description: HTTP status; null for in-process adapters.

token_usage.description: Agent-reported token usage; null when unavailable.

meant.description: WHAT THE AGENT MEANT: exactly one of action/rejected is non-null, discriminated by status. The cross-field coupling is SCHEMA-ENFORCED by the allOf/if/then pair below (a record with status 'parsed' and action null is schema-invalid, not merely doc-invalid). Missed decisions (timeout/agent_error) are status 'rejected' with the corresponding reason (SAFE-4).

status.description: parsed => action non-null, rejected null; rejected => the reverse.

action.description: Canonical parsed action (mirror of ActionParsed payload), or null. The leverage payload (target_lev_1e4, max_slippage_bps) is conditionally required behind intent_kind (allOf/if/then), mirroring the ActionParsed seam: intent_kind is required whenever action is non-null and its sole v1 member is 'leverage_target', so every v1 record still carries the full leverage vector; a future commerce intent kind is a MINOR bump (new enum member + own conditional branch). The keywords are vacuous when action is null (required/properties constrain objects only), so the null branch is unaffected.

intent_kind.description: Canonical intent discriminator, mirror of ActionParsed.intent_kind (the IC-3 seam); constant 'leverage_target' in v1, additive-tolerant (VERSIONING.md) so a future commerce intent kind is a minor bump.

target_lev_1e4.description: Market alias -> signed target leverage, 1e-4 units.

max_slippage_bps.description: Slippage tolerance in bps, or null.

from_attempt.description: Attempt that produced the accepted action.

rejected.description: Mirror of the ActionRejected payload, or null.

reason.description: Final failure reason from the IC-3 validation table.

validator_error.description: Error text fed back on the retry, or null if none occurred.

rules.description: WHICH RULES RAN: every constraint verdict this turn, pass AND block (mirrors of RiskCheck payloads, in emission order). Empty exactly when no action was parsed (gates run only on parsed intents).

verdict.description: The conformance verdict. This enum is on the additive-tolerant list (VERSIONING.md): a future conformance outcome (e.g. step_up / requires_user_authorization) arrives as a minor bump, not a major. observed/limit are numeric-only in v1; a non-scalar conformance value (e.g. a matched-set member) arrives as an optional additive field (minor bump), documented in IC-4.

happened.description: WHAT EXECUTED: verbatim mirrors of this turn's OrderFilled/OrderCancelled/LiquidationTriggered/PostKillSwitchAttempt payloads. All empty/null on missed, rejected, or fully-blocked turns.

fills.description: OrderFilled payloads, in seq order, with full price decomposition.

liquidation.description: LiquidationTriggered payload if this turn's holding bar liquidated the position; else null.

post_kill_switch_attempt.description: PostKillSwitchAttempt payload if a non-flat target arrived after the kill switch; else null.

cost_to_hold.description: WHAT HOLDING COST over this turn's bar: funding flows plus margin state after the bar. The carrying-cost block (funding today; storage/subscription/interest in a commerce profile tomorrow).

funding.description: FundingApplied payloads for settlements crossed during this turn's holding bar, in seq order.

margin_after.description: MarginUpdate payload at the holding bar's close (includes min intra-bar distance-to-liquidation, the wick near-miss); null when flat all bar.

account_after.description: Account state after the turn's bar, with the delta-NAV attribution terms stored (not derived) so 'why did NAV drop this bar' is answered inline and the MATH-2 identity is checkable by a from-scratch script: d_nav == d_price_pnl + d_funding + d_fees + d_liq_penalty, exactly, in integer micro-units.

cash_micro.description: Free cash after the bar, micro-quote.

d_nav_micro.description: NAV change over this turn's bar, micro-quote. INVARIANT (CI, MATH-2): equals the sum of the four attribution terms below.

d_liq_penalty_micro.description: Liquidation penalty component, micro-quote (0 except the terminal bar).

event_seq_range.description: The contiguous events.jsonl seq range this record was derived from - the denormalization is auditable back to the primary stream.

first_seq.description: First event seq of this turn (its ObservationEmitted).

last_seq.description: Last event seq of this turn.

ext.description: Sanctioned extension point (see VERSIONING.md). Recorder-ignored, hashed as-is; values are constrained by schema to JCS-safe types with no fractional numbers ($defs/ext_value).

ext_value.description: JCS-safe extension value (DET-2): null, boolean, string, integer within the I-JSON exact range +/-(2^53-1), or arrays/objects of the same, recursively. A JSON number with a fractional part (e.g. 1.5) is schema-INVALID here - ext contents ride into hashed documents as-is, and no fractional number may enter a hashed document. Boundary note: JSON Schema's 'integer' type admits a mathematically-integral literal such as 1.0; the CI instance scan (float-rejecting JSON parse, see VERSIONING.md) closes that remaining lexical gap.

anyOf.description: JSON string (decimal values ride as strings, e.g. '0.7').
Integer within the I-JSON exact range (JCS round-trips it byte-identically).
Object whose values are all JCS-safe.
